text:
maria: Kickoff - Horizon-20B latency/throughput sweep. Need triage and prioritization. Looking for: 1) ctx-length sensitivity, 2) batch size profiles, 3) quantization perf regressions (int8 vs fp16), 4) warmup/kvcache effects. Who can own quick smoke by EOD? :eyes:

ivan: I can run microbench with our perf harness. Will test ctx=[512,1024,2048,4096], bs=[1,2,4,8], int8/FP16. Any preferred prompt shapes?

maria: short prompts (avg 64 tokens) and long prompts (avg 512). Include a ~1k token assistant completion for tail latency measurement.

sam: tagging in benchbot to queue jobs. benchbot: scheduled jobs created: horizon20b_fp16_short, horizon20b_int8_short, horizon20b_fp16_long, horizon20b_int8_long. ETA ~2h per sweep.

jen: quick note — watch KV-cache cold vs hot. Warmup runs of 5 requests then measure. Cold p95 will be important for PLG edge cases.

ivan: plan: 3-step sweep
```
1) cold-run single-sample latency (no cache)
2) warmup 5 sequential requests, then p50/p95/p99 over 500 queries
3) throughput steady-state with batcher: measure tokens/sec at target latency budgets
```

priya: we should also capture gpu-side metrics (smem, GPU util, CUDA kernels). I'll add perf counters to the runs.

ops-bot: FYI reserved pool limits: d-pool-rt has 2xA100s available, but quant kernels may change memory footprint. Verify OOM risk.

sam: initial smoke results (fp16 vs int8 short prompts): fp16 p95=42ms, int8 p95=38ms, throughput +12% int8 bs=4; but p99 spikes on int8 during kv cache fill. Log snippet:
```
[2026-03-20 14:05:12] kv-fill: 0->1 cache miss
[2026-03-20 14:05:12] kernel-select: fallback to generic GEMM
[2026-03-20 14:05:12] latency: 312ms (p99)
```

ivan: interesting. likely kernel fallback due to sequence length or quant alignment. I'll re-run with alignment pad to 64 and see.

jen: prioritization: if int8 gives 10-15% throughput improvement without steady p99 regressions after kernel alignment -> high priority to expose as "recommended quant profile". If p99 worsens, we need canary + automatic fallback.

maria: action items
- ivan: run alignment pad sweep and report back (ctx 512/1024), include kernel selection logs
- priya: attach GPU counters and memory graphs to bench artifacts
- sam: add canary config to test infra (int8 default but fallback to fp16 for p95>200ms)
- jen: draft short eval note for docs about kv-warmup and p99 caveats

ivan: taking it. will upload artifacts to /bench/horizon20b/2251239876/ by EOD.

maria: thanks team — please react when done. :thumbsup:
